verses.text: Ix awtaj winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová t'a yol mantiado, ix schekan yal juntzanh cheknab'il winh t'a heb' yetisraelal.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Tato ay junok ex tzeyik'kot junok nok' nok' yik snhuschajtz'a smasanil silab'il t'a Jehová, ha t'a skal nok' he wakax, t'a skal nok' he kalnel ma t'a skal nok' he chiwa, hata' tzeyik'kot nok'.

Tato wakax nok' tze nhustz'a silab'il chi', yowalil a junok nok' toro malaj spaltail tzeyik'koti. Ha jun silab' stz'ai, a jun chi' to stz'ab'at nok' nok' chi' smasanil. Ha t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, hata' tzeyak'och silab' chi' yik wach' schaji yuj Jehová.
Yowalil tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok', yik schaji nok' yuj yak'ji lajwok he mul.

Ha mach ay yik nok' chi', a smilancham nok' t'a yichanh Jehová, haxo heb' sacerdote yuninal winhaj Aarón tz'ik'ankot schiq'uil nok', stzikanoch heb' t'a schanhil pak'anh jun altar ayek' t'a yichanh mantiado.
Hanheja' winh ay yik nok' chi' spatz'anel nok', schok' xikanb'at nok' winh.
Haxo heb' sacerdote yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', syak'k'e te' k'atzitz heb' t'a yib'anh te' tzak'ak' t'a altar chi' yik sk'e sk'ak'al.
Tz'ak'jik'e nok' chib'ej kotak xikab'il chi' t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz chi' yet' nok' sjolom yet' nok' xepu' tz'ik'jiel t'a nok' yol sk'ool.

Ha mach tz'ak'an nok' silab' chi', yowalil a smaxan nok' yol sk'ool, sb'ikanel nok' yok, haxo winh sacerdote snhusantz'a jun silab' chi' smasanil t'a yib'anh altar. Suk'uq'ui sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
Tato kalnel, ma chiwa nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', yowalil ch'aak nok', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ha t'a stojolal norte t'a jun altar chi', hata' smiljicham nok' yuj mach tz'ak'an nok' chi' t'a yichanh Jehová. Haxo heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' stzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh jun altar chi'.
Slajwi chi' slaj kotak xikajb'at nok', haxo winh sacerdote tz'ak'ank'e nok' kotak xikab'ilxo yaj chi' t'a yib'anh k'ak' t'a yib'anh altar yet' nok' sjolom yet' nok' xepu' tz'el t'a nok' yol sk'ool.

Haxo jun mach tz'ak'an nok' silab' chi', yowalil a smaxan nok' yol sk'ool, sb'ikanpaxel nok' yok, haxo winh sacerdote snhusantz'a smasanil t'a yib'anh altar. Suk'uq'ui sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
Tato much nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a yichanh Jehová, yowalil a junok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil.
Ha winh sacerdote tz'ik'ankot nok' silab' chi' t'a altar, stok'anel sjolom nok' winh, snhusjitz'a nok'. Haxo schiq'uil nok', stzikoch winh t'a spak'ul altar.
Tz'ik'jielta masanil yooch nok' yet' tas ay t'a yool, syumjikanb'at t'a stz'eyb'at altar t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton b'aj smolchaj k'een tik'aq'uil taanh.

Slajwi chi' syamji sk'axil nok' yik sjekchitanb'at jab'ok nok' winh, palta max chab'axlaj snanhal nok', snhusantz'a nok' winh sacerdote t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz ayk'e t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Suk'uq'ui sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
